preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 200000 for n, m in test_cases) and all(1 <= m <= min(200000, n*(n-1)//2) for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 2 and 200000 inclusive, and m is between 1 and min(200000, n*(n-1)//2) inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i <= 1 for edge in edges for t_i in edge) and all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n for edge in edges for x_i, y_i in edge[1:])
preconditions.description: Each edge has a type t_i (0 for undirected, 1 for directed) and connects vertices x_i and y_i within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(x_i != y_i for edge in edges for x_i, y_i in edge[1:])
preconditions.description: No self-loops exist in the graph.

preconditions.expression: all(not any((x1 == x2 and y1 == y2) or (x1 == y2 and y1 == x2) for i in range(len(edges)) for j in range(i+1, len(edges)) for edge1 in [edges[i]] for edge2 in [edges[j]] for x1, y1 in edge1[1:] for x2, y2 in edge2[1:]))
preconditions.description: No multiple edges exist between the same pair of vertices.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n, m in test_cases) <= 200000 and sum(m for n, m in test_cases) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The sum of n and the sum of m across all test cases do not exceed 200000.

postconditions.description: If the answer is 'NO', output only 'NO'. If the answer is 'YES', output 'YES' followed by exactly m lines describing the directed edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges_output) and all(x != y for x, y in edges_output)
postconditions.description: Each directed edge in the output connects distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(t_i == 1 or (t_i == 0 and (x_i, y_i) in edges_output or (y_i, x_i) in edges_output) for edge in edges for t_i, x_i, y_i in edge)
postconditions.description: All directed edges in the input are preserved in the output. All undirected edges are directed in one of the two possible ways.

postconditions.expression: not any((x, y) in edges_output and (y, x) in edges_output for x, y in edges_output)
postconditions.description: No directed cycles exist in the resulting graph.
If the answer is 'YES', the resulting graph is a directed acyclic graph (DAG).
